purpose: Section 27/31: re-run FWRG/LSB/CONMED/DSGR after all 7 workstreams (A-G) integrated, for regression only - no package-specific tuning performed as a result of these numbers.
noBenchmarkGamingConfirmation: Reused the certification's own existing, unmodified script verbatim. No branching, tuning, or threshold adjustment based on any package's identity or result was made in response to these numbers.

fwrg.explanation: Both changes are the intended, correct effects of this phase's own fixes, not regressions: (1) totalMaterialSemanticUnits/materialTierUnits increased (711->742, 398->418) because BLOCKER-8's findCoordinateClauseSplit (Workstream B) now correctly splits previously-fused sibling claims - e.g. 'shall not create Liens ... or incur Indebtedness ...' - into 2 distinct material units instead of 1, exactly the fix's intended effect. (2) coverageStateBreakdown collapsed entirely to OPERATIVE_STATE_UNRESOLVED because this script deliberately passes operativeState: null (a known, disclosed limitation of this zero-cost regression script, unrelated to real production behavior) - BLOCKER-4's fix (Workstream A) now correctly fails closed on null operativeState for every unit rather than silently letting units resolve their 'real' coverage state without it, which is precisely BLOCKER-4's intended, more conservative behavior. materialUnitsWithoutClaimReviewItem remains 0 - the safe-failure emission mechanism itself is unaffected.

lsb.explanation: Same BLOCKER-4 fail-closed effect as FWRG (this script also passes operativeState: null for LSB). totalMaterialSemanticUnits unchanged (119) - LSB's real Article 6 text apparently had no coordinate-clause-split opportunities BLOCKER-8's fix applies to. materialUnitsWithoutClaimReviewItem remains 0.

structuralRegression.note: Unchanged from the certification baseline - CONMED's structural pipeline was not touched by any of this phase's 7 workstreams (BLOCKER-1's fix, in stage-structure.ts, was verified in Workstream C's own regression to leave CONMED's structural node/anomaly counts at the post-3F.1.5.R baseline it inherited; this script's own re-run confirms the same 2695/366/0 numbers).

conmed.semanticCoverage: NOT_AVAILABLE - as disclosed by the certification itself and unchanged by this phase: no semantic-coverage (Phase 3E) fixture exists for CONMED anywhere in this repository. Discovered-material-claim counts, semantic-representation-state counts, and claim-review-item-would-be-created counts are honestly NOT AVAILABLE zero-cost for CONMED, reported as null rather than fabricated. This is not a new gap introduced by this remediation phase.

dsgr.finding: materialUnitsWithoutClaimReviewItem = 215 (not 0) for DSGR. Independently root-caused before accepting or hiding this number.
rootCauseInvestigation: Confirmed via `git diff 77f6e11 HEAD -- lib/contract-model/compiler/safe-failure/` (the entire safe-failure module - derive.ts, integrate.ts, service.ts, identity.ts, types.ts): ZERO changes. None of the 7 workstreams touched any file in this directory.

Confirmed via `git diff 77f6e11 HEAD -- tests/fixtures/unseen-packages/phase-3f1-dsgr-remediation-regression/stage8-coverage-result.json`: ZERO changes - the exact same fixture file, byte-for-byte, as at the certification's own close.

Confirmed no leftover Postgres state from a prior incomplete run (`prisma.company.findMany`/`claimReviewItem.count` for the scratch company id both returned empty/0 before this run) - the DSGR company is created fresh and torn down at the end of every invocation of this script, in complete isolation from FWRG/LSB.

This run's totalMaterialSemanticUnits for DSGR is 7517 - this EXACTLY matches the 'before regeneration' figure the certification's OWN Section 28 artifact (docs/phase-3f1-6-final-foundation-certification/26-known-package-regression.json, reproducibilityAndFixtureFreshnessFinding) already disclosed: 'DSGR total unit count 7517 -> 7349 ... because the checked-in fixture was generated at an earlier commit ... All fixture files this audit's scripts touched were deliberately reverted via git checkout -- immediately after this audit captured the numbers it needed.'

Conclusion: the certification's own reported 'dsgr: 0' in 30-certification-findings.json / 26-known-package-regression.json was computed against a transiently-regenerated (7349-unit) fixture that was deliberately reverted back to the older, currently-committed 7517-unit fixture immediately afterward, per the certification's own documented, disclosed methodology. This run necessarily uses the currently-committed (older, 7517-unit) fixture - the same one that has been sitting in the repository the whole time - and that older fixture genuinely contains 215 material-tier units that reach a reviewable coverage state without producing a review item, most likely because they lack a real structural anchor (deriveFromCoverageEntry's own, unmodified, pre-existing `if (!anchor) return null` fail-silent path - see its own header comment: 'should not occur in practice ... except the raw-source-fallback path').
dsgr.classification: PRE-EXISTING, DISCLOSED FIXTURE-VERSIONING ARTIFACT - NOT a regression introduced by any of the 7 remediation workstreams, NOT one of the 11 certified BLOCKER findings, and NOT the safe-failure mechanism failing on live/fresh computation (FWRG and LSB, computed fresh in this same run, both show materialUnitsWithoutClaimReviewItem=0, proving the mechanism itself is sound). Regenerating DSGR's fixture to get a true zero-cost 0 would require the same expensive real-LLM-call pipeline run the certification itself declined to repeat live, and doing so here would be an unbounded scope expansion forbidden by this phase's own charter (Section 24, Section 29) - not attempted.
dsgr.recommendedFollowUp: A future phase that regenerates and permanently commits a fresh DSGR semantic-coverage fixture (rather than reverting it after each measurement) would let this exact check be re-verified honestly at 0. Out of scope here.

overallConclusion: No package-specific production tuning occurred. FWRG and LSB's changes are the correct, intended, disclosed effects of BLOCKER-4 and BLOCKER-8's fixes visible in real end-to-end data. CONMED's structural numbers are unchanged and its semantic-coverage gap remains honestly disclosed as NOT_AVAILABLE, exactly as before. DSGR's non-zero materialUnitsWithoutClaimReviewItem count is a pre-existing, disclosed fixture-freshness artifact independent of this phase's changes, not a new safe-failure regression.
